verdict.rationale: 2FAS Pass lets users decide where their vault lives: their own cloud, an encrypted file on an external drive, or self-hosted storage. 2FAS Auth syncs only to the user's personal iCloud or Google Drive, and a community report corroborates iCloud, WebDAV and local-file backup options, so the user, not the vendor, controls data location. Missing for 10: explicit geographic region/residency documentation (residency is only implied by the user's choice of storage provider), and detailed self-hosting/WebDAV setup docs.
